description: This file defines a PHP class extending database connection functionalities specifically for handling SQLite databases. It provides methods for transaction management, schema inspection, SQL generation, and error handling, along with classes for recordset management tailored to SQLite.
external_files: sqlite3 extension functions (e.g., sqlite_open, sqlite_last_insert_rowid, sqlite_changes, sqlite_query, sqlite_num_fields, sqlite_fetch_array, sqlite_create_function, sqlite_error_string, sqlite_close)

classes.name: ADODB_sqlite
classes.description: Driver class implementing SQLite specific database operations within the ADOdb abstraction layer.

classes.name: ADORecordset_sqlite
classes.description: Recordset class for handling query results from SQLite databases, extending ADORecordSet.

methods.name: ServerInfo
methods.description: Returns an array with version, description, and encoding info about the SQLite library.

methods.name: BeginTrans
methods.description: Starts a database transaction.

methods.name: CommitTrans
methods.description: Commits the current transaction if successful, otherwise rolls back.

methods.name: RollbackTrans
methods.description: Rolls back the current transaction.

methods.name: MetaColumns
methods.description: Retrieves column info for a specified table.

methods.name: _init
methods.description: Initializes driver properties related to transaction capabilities.

methods.name: _insertID
methods.description: Retrieves the last insert ID for a table.

methods.name: _affectedrows
methods.description: Returns the number of rows affected by the last operation.

methods.name: ErrorMsg
methods.description: Gets the latest error message.

methods.name: ErrorNo
methods.description: Gets the latest error number.

methods.name: SQLDate
methods.description: Generates SQL for date formatting.

methods.name: _createFunctions
methods.description: Creates custom SQLite functions for date handling.

methods.name: _connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to a SQLite database.

methods.name: _pconnect
methods.description: Establishes a persistent connection to a SQLite database.

methods.name: _query
methods.description: Executes a SQL query.

methods.name: SelectLimit
methods.description: Executes a SQL query with limit and offset.

methods.name: GenID
methods.description: Generates a unique ID using a sequence table.

methods.name: CreateSequence
methods.description: Creates a new sequence table for ID generation.

methods.name: DropSequence
methods.description: Drops a sequence table.

methods.name: _close
methods.description: Closes the database connection.

methods.name: MetaIndexes
methods.description: Retrieves index info for a table.

methods.name: charMax
methods.description: Returns maximum size of character fields; limited as per database design.

methods.name: textMax
methods.description: Returns maximum size of text fields; limited as per database design.

methods.name: month
methods.description: Generates SQL to extract month from a date.

methods.name: day
methods.description: Generates SQL to extract day from a date.

methods.name: year
methods.description: Generates SQL to extract year from a date.
